summary.text: Héctor Arzeno, a Democrat, was sworn in in November 2023 to represent the 151st District, which covers Greenwich, in the Connecticut House.

paragraphs.text: He was born and raised in Buenos Aires, Argentina, became a U.S. citizen in 1987, and has more than 40 years of experience in international finance.
He holds a degree in business administration from the Catholic University of Argentina and has lived in Greenwich since 1986.
He was elected to Greenwich's Representative Town Meeting in November 2019.
